always_encrypted.description: Require TLS for connections through the tunnel.

asm_staging_directory.description: ASM staging directory path. Required when the ASM option is enabled.

cdb_database.description: Optional: CDB database name for TDE-encrypted containerized databases.

cdb_user.description: Optional: CDB user for TDE-encrypted containerized databases.

client.description: The SAP NetWeaver client. Required when `sapConnectionMode` is `NETWEAVER`.

connection_type.description: Possible values:`Directly`, `PrivateLink`, `SshTunnel`. `SshTunnel` is used if this parameter is omitted and any of these parameters is provided: `tunnel_host`, `tunnel_port`, or `tunnel_user`. If the parameter is omitted  and none of those tunnel parameters are specified, `Directly` is used.

convert_dats_type_to_date.description: (Immutable) Whether SAP DATS columns are coerced to LocalDate on newly added tables. When false, DATS columns stay String. Cannot be changed after Save & Test. Default value: `true`.

enable_archive_log_only_mode.description: Default value: `false`. Set to `true` to capture changes exclusively from archived redo logs, without reading from the online redo log.

enable_asm.description: Default value: `false`. Set to `true` if you're using ASM.

enable_symbolic_links.description: Default value: `false`. Set to `true` if you're using symbolic links.

enable_tde_encryption.description: Default value: `false`. Set to `true` if Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) is enabled.

host.description: Database instance host name or IP address.

local_wallet_host.description: Optional: The host for the local Oracle Wallet.

local_wallet_user.description: Optional: The user for the local Oracle Wallet.

oracle2_update_method.description: The update method for Oracle. Supported values: `BINARY_LOG_READER`. Default value: `BINARY_LOG_READER`.

sap_connection_mode.description: The SAP Oracle connection mode. Supported values: `DIRECT`, `NETWEAVER`. Default value: `DIRECT`.

symbolic_links_mapping.description: Mapping of symbolic links to actual file paths. Required when symbolic links are enabled.

sysnr.description: The SAP NetWeaver system number. Required when `sapConnectionMode` is `NETWEAVER`.

tde_wallet_password.description: The TDE wallet password. Required for password-based wallets.

tunnel_host.description: SSH host. Specify only when connecting via an SSH tunnel (do not use a load balancer).

tunnel_port.description: SSH port. Specify only when connecting via an SSH tunnel.

tunnel_user.description: SSH user. Specify only when connecting via an SSH tunnel.
